outline.scope: Exact Project 4 extract; source DOCX digest supplied by document owner

method.reference_scope: Measured and reference compute use the same effective work F and participating chip count k within each efficiency calculation. The calibrated reference is not a proven theoretical upper bound or vendor peak.

requirements.timing: Matched-workload uninstrumented synchronized wall clock including transfer, communication and synchronization; no estimated subtraction of instrumentation overhead.
requirements.reference: Independent calibration, necessary workload, actual stage dependencies, resource overlap and necessary scheduling; exclude redundant work and extra implementation waiting.
forbidden_reference_substitutes: reverse fitting to measured B0 or B1 time
requirements.comparison: Same reference method; separately derive reference time when precision, workload or execution path differs. Efficiency ratios under different references are not performance gains.

common_conditions: physical accelerator model, count and interconnect

pending_evidence: Validated effective-work mapping including accepted draft attribution

Independent reference with actual dependencies, overlap and applicability

historical_instrumented.classification: historical empirical-resource reference, not current V1.5 efficiency or acceptance

cost_method.request_population: Same requests initiated and successfully completed inside the measurement interval; cross-interval usage separate
cost_method.cards: All occupied cards; no utilization discount on fixed fees
cost_method.utilization: Same interval, per-node/card AI Core samples, time-weighted means

c16_fixed_b0.scope: Input identity audit, not quality acceptance or isolated MOD attribution

historical_development_pair_resource_cos.scope: Recomputed historical resource coefficient; not new V1.5 monetary acceptance
